# TNND user-facing design guidance

Before modifying a UI, copy, navigation, style, interaction, responsive state or accessibility behavior, read `.agents/skills/product-design-expert/SKILL.md`, `docs/design/PRODUCT_PROFILE.md` and the relevant references. TNND's approved Neo Bento design system remains authoritative. Validate web and extension contexts separately. Don't add unrelated redesigns to backend tasks.
